# function: color_from_hex

Reads #rrggbb or #rgb with the Philips Wide RGB D65 formula and returns color_xy, rounded to four decimal places, and brightness, the largest RGB channel as a percentage rounded to two decimal places. The formula reaches the full gamut of Hue lights, so a color can look more saturated on a light than on a screen. Black has no color and is an error. In scene actions, merge it with the other settings, function first, so that the settings you write win: merge(provider::hue::color_from_hex("#ff8800"), { on = true, brightness = 40 }). Requires Terraform 1.8 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hue_scene" "sunset" {
  name  = "Sunset"
  group = hue_zone.desk.id
  actions = {
    # { color_xy = { x = 0.601, y = 0.3837 }, brightness = 40, on = true }
    (data.hue_light.desk.id) = merge(provider::hue::color_from_hex("#ff8800"), { on = true, brightness = 40 })
  }
}
```
